text: Thousands of government schemes exist to help people across India. Most people never hear about the ones meant for them.
Meet YojanaSahay. One free app that finds them for you.
Home brings it all together: data checked against official portals, a quick eligibility check, and help for big moments in life, like a new baby or building a house.
Search finds any scheme in an instant, by name, ministry or state.
Schemes lists over twelve hundred Central and State schemes, with filters for farmers, students, women and more. Open one to see the benefit and exactly how to apply.
Not sure what you qualify for? Answer a few quick questions, and see every scheme that matches you, in seconds.
AI Help answers in Hindi or English. It finds schemes for you and your family, explains why you're not eligible, compares schemes, and even checks if a message is a scam.
Set up your profile once, and every result and answer is made for you.
Switch to Hindi or dark mode in one tap, and use it on the web, as an Android app, or right inside Telegram.
About tells the full story: the mission, where the data comes from, and how your privacy is protected.
YojanaSahay is free and independent, designed and built end to end by one developer, Sahnawaz Ahmed Laskar.
Find the schemes meant for you, at yojanasahay.vercel.app
